nodes.summary: Seeds the customer accounts-receivable flow: a sample debit note through the billing-document service and a matching payment receipt through the idempotent payment-allocation path.

nodes.name: seedCustomerAr
nodes.summary: Entry point seeding the debit note and its payment receipt for the AR demo flow.

nodes.name: seedDebitNote
nodes.summary: Generates and saves a draft debit note from a seeded trip via the billing-document service.

nodes.name: seedPaymentReceipt
nodes.summary: Records a payment receipt against the seeded debit note through the payment-allocation service.

nodes.name: seed-customers.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds demo customers with normalized tax codes for idempotent re-runs, default company-info settings, and the customized Long Minh debit-note template.

nodes.name: seedCustomers
nodes.summary: Upserts demo customer rows keyed by normalized tax code and returns a code-to-customer map for downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seedCompanySettings
nodes.summary: Writes the default company-info settings rows used by document rendering.

nodes.name: seedLongMinhDebitTemplate
nodes.summary: Seeds the customized debit-note template (own column layout) for the Long Minh customer.

nodes.name: seed-demo-freight-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Creates deterministic demo rate terms, route/vehicle size classes, fuel price periods and consumption norms, converging configured 15T prices for repeatable pricing QA.

nodes.name: seedDemoFreightPricing
nodes.summary: Converges the demo freight-pricing dataset: vehicle sizes, effective fuel data, routes, real anchor rates and explicitly marked demo freight terms and15T prices for LONG MINH.

nodes.name: ensureVehicleSizeClasses
nodes.summary: Adds missing canonical vehicle-size classes by code without replacing existing classes.

nodes.name: ensureFuelPricePeriods
nodes.summary: Adds supplied real fuel-price periods only when their effective start date is absent.

nodes.name: ensureFuelConsumptionNorms
nodes.summary: Converges canonical fuel-consumption norms by vehicle class and effective date, refreshing existing or soft-deleted demo rows.

nodes.name: ensurePricingRoutes
nodes.summary: Adds missing pricing routes by normalized name while preserving existing route master data.

nodes.name: ensureAnchorPricingRungs
nodes.summary: Inserts missing positive Excel-derived customer-route-size anchor rates at the seed effective date without overwriting existing prices.

nodes.name: convergeFreightRateTerms
nodes.summary: Upserts demo customer-route freight terms, explicitly clearing the unused threshold mode and restoring soft-deleted rows.

nodes.name: convergeDemo15TPrices
nodes.summary: Upserts explicitly marked demo15T rates by customer, route and effective date, restoring rows withheld by blank source spreadsheets.

nodes.name: seed-factories.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds factory master-data rows linked to customers so the shipment-intake factory dropdown is populated.

nodes.name: seedFactories
nodes.summary: Idempotently inserts factory rows tied to seeded customers using normalized-name matching.

nodes.name: seed-forwarder-money.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds direct recorded OPS advances, exactly matched completed expenses and one balanced settlement with the unused advance returned. Reruns are owner-scoped and preserve settled or ambiguous historical entries.

nodes.name: seedForwarderMoney
nodes.summary: Seeds owned OPS advances and the balanced demo settlement through domain services without a human approval handoff.

nodes.name: seedAdvances
nodes.summary: Creates only missing advance fixtures for the designated OPS owner using each exact plan reason.

nodes.name: seedSettlement
nodes.summary: Records a balanced demo settlement only when all exact owned advances and matching unclaimed expenses exist; derives the unused-cash refund and avoids duplicate settlement creation.

nodes.name: findUnsettledSeedExpenses
nodes.summary: Recovers only exact owned, recorded, unclaimed OPS demo fees after an interrupted seed; matches shipment, dispatcher, assignment, date, amounts and evidence metadata, rejecting ambiguous duplicates.

nodes.name: seed-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Shared identity-matching contract for all seeders: text normalization plus Drizzle SQL predicates for idempotent lookups on normalized (and nullable) text columns.

nodes.name: normalizeSeedText
nodes.summary: Trims and lowercases seed text for stable identity matching across re-runs.

nodes.name: normalizedTextEquals
nodes.summary: Builds a Drizzle SQL predicate comparing a column to a value under seed normalization.

nodes.name: normalizedNullableTextEquals
nodes.summary: Nullable variant of the normalized-equality predicate that handles NULL column values.

nodes.name: _enums.ts
nodes.summary: Application-owned enum definitions for trip, shipment, financial, OPS and master-data statuses and types. applicationEnum uses PostgreSQL text storage while shared application contracts validate accepted values.

nodes.name: _shared.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny helper module providing the applicationEnum factory that backs every enum definition in the schema layer.

nodes.name: applicationEnum
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a Drizzle text column builder with a const-typed tuple of allowed values and attaches enumValues metadata, giving schemas compile-time exhaustiveness without native PostgreSQL enums.

nodes.name: core.ts
nodes.summary: Platform-level tables: users with RBAC roles, business units and calendar days, audit logs, app settings, durable effect jobs, notifications, push subscriptions, photo geotags, scheduler run logs, and idempotency keys.

nodes.name: costs.ts
nodes.summary: Defines company and trip expenses, evidence and driver operational/cost records. Native expense rows hold classification and recovery metadata used by the expense-accounting provenance bridge.

nodes.name: expense-metadata.ts
nodes.summary: Provides shared Drizzle columns for native OPS and driver expense classification, payer, negotiated customer recovery, invoice identity and evidence keys.

nodes.name: expenseMetadataColumns
nodes.summary: Returns native expense classification, payer, customer recovery, invoice and evidence columns for reuse by Drizzle owner tables.

nodes.name: financial.ts
nodes.summary: Financial schema for trip postings, ledger, billing documents/claims, period locks, reporting profiles, salary confirmations including frozen snapshots, settlements, credit exceptions and profitability snapshots. The former persisted governance queue is absent.

nodes.name: master-data.ts
nodes.summary: Master-data tables for fleet and commercial entities: trucks, trailers, drivers with nullable salary-effective-date metadata and truck assignments, partners, suppliers, tires and positions, customers with user links, routes, cargo/container/seal types, dispatch zones, ports, forwarder expense types, operational sites, master-import batches and row results, and carrier fleet vehicles. The stored effective date does not by itself establish payroll calculation behavior.

nodes.name: ops.ts
nodes.summary: Defines OPS shipment assignments, expense entries, photos and settlement links, including native expense classification, payer, invoice and recovery metadata.

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Pricing configuration tables: per customer-route pricing tables, road allowances and road config, fuel config with price history and fuel norms, weight pricing tiers, lift pricing, ancillary revenue, and penalty reasons.

nodes.name: shipments.ts
nodes.summary: The shipment (lô) dossier schema: shipments with documents, declarations, status history, containers, fulfillments and recovery facts, accounting locks, document custody facts, proof-of-delivery submissions and files, milestones, customer-visible events, delivery attempts and responses, email logs, and dispatch handoffs.

nodes.name: trips.ts
nodes.summary: Defines trip execution and financial state plus the composed read view, including reconciled toll and extra costs alongside estimated costs and operational assignments.

nodes.name: billingDocument.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes debit-note freight line descriptions by upgrading system-generated 'Cước vận chuyển' labels to route-based wording while preserving accountant-authored text. Part of the shared billing-document calculation helpers used by backend document generation and frontend previews alike.

nodes.name: canonicalFreightDescription
nodes.summary: Rewrites TRIP-sourced freight descriptions that match known generated-label patterns into the canonical 'Cước vận chuyển — <route>' form; accountant-authored descriptions pass through untouched.

nodes.name: iso6346.ts
nodes.summary: ISO 6346 container-number toolkit: normalizes and validates the owner-code/serial format, computes the standard check digit from the letter-value mapping, and ranks typo-correction suggestions for near-miss container numbers.

nodes.name: normalizeContainerNumber
nodes.summary: Strips dashes and whitespace from a container number and uppercases it for canonical comparison.

nodes.name: validateContainerFormat
nodes.summary: Checks that a container number matches the ISO 6346 owner-code (3 letters + category letter) and 6-digit serial format.

nodes.name: calculateCheckDigit
nodes.summary: Computes the ISO 6346 check digit by summing letter-mapped values weighted by powers of two and mapping the sum modulo 11 onto the standard digit sequence.

nodes.name: validateCheckDigit
nodes.summary: Verifies that a full 11-character container number's trailing check digit matches the recomputed ISO 6346 value.

nodes.name: validateContainerNumber
nodes.summary: Full container-number validation combining format and check-digit checks, returning a structured result instead of a bare boolean.

nodes.name: suggestCorrections
nodes.summary: Ranks up to maxResults typo corrections for an invalid container number by mutating single digits (and owner letters) and scoring candidates whose recomputed check digit validates, preferring mutations closest to the original.

nodes.name: vehicleAlerts.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, deterministic helper turning a truck's compliance dates (inspection, insurance, oil service) into overdue/due alerts sorted by urgency, parsing dates as local midnight so timezones never shift the day count.

nodes.name: parseLocalMidnight
nodes.summary: Parses a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string as local-midnight milliseconds, returning NaN for empty or malformed input so callers can drop it with a Number.isFinite guard.

nodes.name: computeVehicleAlerts
nodes.summary: Computes overdue/due alerts for inspection, insurance, and oil-service dates using ceil-based day diffs and an injectable lead window, returning only non-OK alerts sorted by days remaining.

nodes.name: company-info.ts
nodes.summary: Single-purpose helper deciding whether white-label company profile setup is complete by validating the row against companyInfoSchema, since seeded installations carry blank placeholder rows that timestamps cannot distinguish.

nodes.name: isCompanyInfoConfigured
nodes.summary: Returns true only when a company profile object exists and passes companyInfoSchema.safeParse, separating a fully configured profile from untouched seeded placeholders.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical shared constants module for the monorepo: lifecycle enums (TripStatus, ShipmentStatus, custody and document types), Vietnamese label maps for statuses, roles, costs, and evidence types, financial-role checks, push-notification rules, and dispatch classifications consumed by backend, frontend, and the Zod schema layer.

nodes.name: canonicalShipmentStatus
nodes.summary: Maps raw or legacy shipment status strings onto the canonical ShipmentStatus enum, providing read compatibility for rows created before the 2026 workflow re-definition.

nodes.name: isFinancialRole
nodes.summary: Type guard checking whether a user role belongs to the FINANCIAL_ROLES set that grants accounting-side visibility.

nodes.name: expense-accounting.ts
nodes.summary: Defines expense source kinds, cost groups, suggestions, integer-VND and calendar-date validation, command schemas, versioned references, worksheet rows and cash/reconciliation response contracts.

nodes.name: cus-shipment-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Zod contract layer for the CUS (chứng từ) shipment workspace: strict paginated query schemas for the overview and container workboards plus response, detail, and container-line schemas covering finance summaries, document custody, accounting locks, debit notes, and recovery facts.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zod schema module and barrel for trips, billing documents, debit-note templates, users, master data, expenses, advances, shipments, dispatch and driver progress, with reusable numeric transforms for PostgreSQL numeric fields. Driver requests accept salaryEffectiveDate as an optional nullable ISO calendar date; this validates the stored field without implementing effective-dated payroll calculations. Quick-create optionally validates a trimmed initial declaration of at most 50 characters for atomic intake.

nodes.name: fixedScaleDecimal
nodes.summary: Factory producing a Zod transform that accepts number-or-string input and normalizes it to a fixed-scale decimal string (padding the fraction part), rejecting malformed or over-precise values via ctx.addIssue.

nodes.name: withOptionalContainerNumberGate
nodes.summary: Allows omitted container numbers, but rejects supplied blanks, malformed owner/serial formats and invalid ISO6346 check digits with field-specific errors.

nodes.name: validateShipmentDocumentReferences
nodes.summary: Allows pending document references, but rejects simultaneous Bill and Booking values and direction mismatches: IMPORT uses Bill and EXPORT uses Booking, with field-specific issues.

nodes.name: validateShipmentAdHocIdentity
nodes.summary: Requires a catalog customer for standard shipments or a nonblank raw customer name for explicitly ad-hoc orders.

nodes.name: rejectDuplicateCarrierAllocations
nodes.summary: Rejects duplicate carrier allocations within the same appointment date, or across the allocation list when no dates are supplied.

nodes.name: penalty-list.ts
nodes.summary: Zod query contracts for the admin penalty log API: a strict server-side pagination/filter/sort schema for GET /api/penalties and a month/year schema for the server-computed KPI insights endpoint, replacing the former client-side aggregation.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript domain contracts for users, trips, shipments, expenses, billing, salary, fleet and dispatch, including direct-record statuses and explicit confirmed-salary snapshot metadata.

nodes.name: parseThreshold
nodes.summary: Coerces a raw setting value to a finite number with a caller-supplied fallback, used when reading numeric threshold configuration.

nodes.name: fuelSurcharge.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the customer fuel surcharge when the current fuel price exceeds the contractual base price, splitting the delta by the customer's share percentage over a quota in liters. Returns a zero/non-applicable result whenever any price, share, or quota input is missing or the precondition fails.

nodes.name: computeFuelSurcharge
nodes.summary: Calculates the surcharge as (currentPrice − basePrice) × quotaLiters × sharePct/100, rounded to 2dp then to a whole number via roundInt. Guards against null prices/share, non-positive share or quota, and currentPrice ≤ basePrice by returning { amount: 0, applicable: false }.

nodes.name: computeFreightRate
nodes.summary: Calculates whole-VND base freight including revenue share plus a fuel-price-difference surcharge clamped to zero, rounding intermediates to two decimals before whole-unit rounding.

nodes.name: round.ts
nodes.summary: Shared rounding helpers: symmetric decimal-place rounding through scientific notation and nonnegative nearest-integer rounding for whole fuel liters. Decimal ties round away from zero, not banker half-even rounding.

nodes.name: round2dp
nodes.summary: Rounds to two decimal places using scientific-notation shifting and symmetric sign handling; half ties round away from zero.

nodes.name: roundInt
nodes.summary: Rounds to the nearest integer and clamps negative results to zero for whole-liter and whole-amount calculations.

nodes.name: tripTotals.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates shared trip revenue, cost and margin using financial rounding, preferring confirmed actual tolls when available and including separately reconciled extra costs for owned and external transport.

nodes.name: computeRoadAllowance
nodes.summary: Derives the driver road allowance: when tollsAddition is positive it replaces the base rate entirely (plus return-cargo bonus), otherwise it uses base − (toll stations × per-station toll) + bonus; subtracts tollsDiscount and clamps the result at zero.

nodes.name: computeTripTotals
nodes.summary: Main trip totals function: resolves fuel liters by precedence (FLAT_RATE → fixed mountain/route allowance → per-leg km×norm) with whole-liter rounding, then assembles the P&L — fuel cost at the effective price (actual ?? standard) with variance tracking, road allowance honoring manual override, net toll cost (gross − kẹp-hàng tollDeduction clamped ≥ 0), freightExVat/recordedRevenue after VAT and customer commission, and the OWN (fuel+allowance+tolls+salary+bonuses) vs EXTERNAL (incl-VAT freight cost only) cost branches.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Allowlist-style Docker build-context filter for the backend image: excludes everything with a root `*`, then re-includes only the pnpm workspace manifests, shared/backend sources, and Drizzle migration files that backend/Dockerfile actually COPYs, keeping the root context intact so pnpm workspace links still resolve.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the TingTing backend API: a builder stage installs workspace dependencies with pnpm 10 and compiles the shared and backend TypeScript packages, then a minimal node:22-alpine runtime stage ships only the pruned node_modules, dist output, Casbin policies, Drizzle migrations, and BeVietnamPro fonts, running `node dist/index.js` on port 3090.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Builder stage on node:22-alpine that activates pnpm 10.33.0 via corepack, runs a frozen-lockfile install for @tingting/backend and its workspace dependencies, compiles shared and backend TypeScript with a cached incremental build, and emits a pruned production dependency tree at /prod/backend via `pnpm deploy`.

nodes.name: production
nodes.summary: Runtime stage on node:22-alpine that copies the pruned node_modules and compiled dist from the builder, adds static assets tsc does not emit (Casbin model.conf/policy.csv, Drizzle migration SQL plus meta journal, BeVietnamPro fonts for document rendering), creates the uploads directory, and serves the API on exposed port 3090 under NODE_ENV=production.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that strips node_modules, VCS/agent-tool state, test and QA artifacts, dist builds, backend tests, drizzle migration snapshots, docs/plans, and all env files from image builds, keeping only README.md and .env.example as negation exceptions.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: The repository's binding agent contract: strict trunk-based git workflow (no branches, worktrees, or PRs), closed-loop SDLC with mandatory QA gates (lint, typecheck, backend/frontend tests, build, E2E), testplan-first regression rules for user-reported bugs, and a strict UI-verification claim ladder that forbids calling anything tested without browser-interaction evidence.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Compact development-context entrypoint defining the authority order for conflicting sources, the repository shape (shared contracts/calculations, Express+Drizzle backend, React frontend, e2e, docs/prd, deploy), core invariants (Drizzle-only SQL policy, round2dp financial math, JWT+Casbin gating), and the progressive context-loading protocol with dev endpoints.

nodes.name: docker-compose.dev.yml
nodes.summary: Local development infrastructure uses ss-prod-db pgvector Postgres on5441, ss-prod-redis on6391 and ss-prod-adminer on8083, with health checks and persistent silversea-pgdata. Container names avoid the sibling ss-main stack.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Developer and release commands for the local ss-prod-db stack, backups and migrations, database sync, and separate staging latest/prod branch image deployments. Staging demo preserves DB without backups; production deploy requires a clean prod branch, captures image rollback metadata and backs up DB before migration.

nodes.name: dev
nodes.summary: Starts local compose infrastructure and backend/frontend; attempts backup and migrations with warnings if they fail, then owns child process shutdown.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: Requires a successful local database backup before applying Drizzle migrations.

nodes.name: db-recreate
nodes.summary: Terminates connections and destructively recreates the configured local database in ss-prod-db.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Uses a portable lock directory to serialize Drizzle migration generation.

nodes.name: db-backup
nodes.summary: Writes a timestamped custom-format dump and rejects failed or implausibly small backups.

nodes.name: db-drift-check
nodes.summary: Requires a clean migration tree, runs a schema drift probe and removes only probe changes after reporting drift.

nodes.name: devdb
nodes.summary: Copies staging database into disposable local dev data through the shared sync target.

nodes.name: devdb-prod
nodes.summary: Copies production database into disposable local dev data through the shared sync target.

nodes.name: devdb-sync
nodes.summary: Discovers remote Postgres credentials, streams a verified dump locally, restores the local ss-prod-db database, and reports schema counts.

nodes.name: stgdb
nodes.summary: Copies production data to staging after stopping staging writers and retaining a staging backup; replaces staging schemas and restarts the stack.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Starts local infrastructure, recreates the database, applies migrations and seeds development data.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds shared contracts, backend and frontend in dependency order.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops local backend and frontend development processes while leaving infrastructure running.

nodes.name: down
nodes.summary: Stops the local compose stack including database and Redis.

nodes.name: demo
nodes.summary: Builds and pushes latest images, migrates and restarts staging without replacing DB, then checks deployed frontend assets and public health.

nodes.name: deploy-advance
nodes.summary: Fetches origin and advances the prod branch to origin/main through fast-forward behavior.

nodes.name: deploy-db-backup
nodes.summary: Runs the production server database backup script.

nodes.name: deploy-server-setup
nodes.summary: Runs initial production host provisioning and hardening.

nodes.name: deploy-seed
nodes.summary: Runs the idempotent production master-data seed in the deployed backend image.

nodes.name: deploy
nodes.summary: Requires a clean prod checkout, captures current deployment image metadata and backs up DB before serialized migration, service cutover, asset verification and public health checks.

nodes.name: help
nodes.summary: Lists documented make targets and local/staging/production entrypoints.

nodes.name: tsconfig.build.json

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Base TypeScript config for the backend package: extends the monorepo-root tsconfig.base.json, emits to dist with src as rootDir, and enables incremental builds with a .tsbuildinfo cache; includes all of src for dev-time typechecking.

nodes.name: docker-compose.prod.yml
nodes.summary: Staging Docker Compose stack for vantai.tingting.vip with project name vantai: pgvector Postgres16, Redis7, backend/frontend on the latest image channel, dedicated /opt/vantai data volumes and opt-in localhost Adminer. The real production stack is docker-compose.silversea.yml.

nodes.name: docker-compose.silversea.yml
nodes.summary: Production Docker Compose stack for silversea.tingting.vip (project 'silversea'), pinned to the :prod image channel so demo deploys can never clobber prod. It owns dedicated data volumes under /opt/silversea/data that deploys never touch, and is driven by the root Makefile's PROD_COMPOSE target (`make deploy`), which only recreates backend/frontend.

nodes.name: seed-staging-2026-08-05-customer-sites.sql
nodes.summary: Staging hotfix for the empty factory dropdown (DEF-20260804-002): upserts operational sites for Bien Bac (factory + warehouse), XNK Ha Noi (ICD warehouse + Bac Son factory), and a Long Minh smoke-test factory, mirroring the backend TypeScript seeder committed in 6d2c0bd.

nodes.name: seed-staging-quytrinh-sites.sql
nodes.summary: Deferred staging seed that upserts 8 Long Minh operational sites from the customer's DATA PM Excel — 3 NEWEB warehouses (Ha Nam/Ninh Binh), 2 ASKEY factories, SUNRISE, SJ Tech, and S-CONNECT (Bac Ninh) — each with Google Maps links, lift-fee invoice details, and driver-facing strict_rules. It requires migration 0170 (operational_sites), so it must be applied only after a backend image redeploy.

nodes.name: seed-staging-quytrinh.sql
nodes.summary: Additive, idempotent staging upsert of real customer master data from the 2026-07-30 Excel delivery: Silver Sea company identity into app_settings, the Long Minh partner/supplier/customer triple (MST 2300540419, 15-day freight payment terms), the 19-column 'MAU DEBIT LONG MINH' debit-note template stored as a JSONB column layout, and a repoint of the khachhang portal user to the Long Minh customer. Preserves existing demo trips and users.

nodes.name: seed-vantai-6months.sql
nodes.summary: Extended variant of the vantai demo seed that spreads the same master data across six months of trips (VT-2601 through VT-2606, almost entirely LOCKED, with trip code counters per month) and randomized created_at/updated_at timestamps — built to exercise monthly reporting, salary-period, and AR-aging screens.

nodes.name: seed-vantai.sql
nodes.summary: Clean-slate demo seed for vantai.tingting.vip: truncates ~35 tables with CASCADE, resets sequences, then loads realistic Vietnamese trucking data — 9 users, 7 trucks, 6 trailers, 6 drivers, 7 suppliers, 10 real logistics customers, 12 Hai Phong routes with JSONB default legs, pricing and road-allowance tables, fuel config, container types, and 14 ports — plus 30 trips across May–June 2026 with legs, forwarder expenses, ledger entries, and vehicle expenses.

nodes.name: setup-silversea-server.sh
nodes.summary: One-time, idempotent provisioning script for the prod server silversea.tingting.vip, run via `make deploy-server-setup`: 11 steps covering DNS sanity, Docker install, /opt/silversea layout, fresh secret generation with shared keys mirrored from the demo .env, compose push, nginx + certbot with a webroot HTTP-01 certificate, auto-renew hooks with a dry-run proof, ufw/SSH hardening, and finally starting postgres + redis for `make deploy` to fill in.

nodes.name: silversea-server-db-backup.sh
nodes.summary: Pre-deploy safety net that pg_dumps the production database via docker exec, discovering POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_DB from the container environment; it aborts the deploy when the dump is suspiciously small on a populated database, keeping the suspect file for inspection.

nodes.name: drizzle.config.ts
nodes.summary: Configures Drizzle schema discovery, database access and timestamp-prefixed migration generation.

nodes.name: model.conf
nodes.summary: Casbin authorization model defining a subject/object/action request schema with an allow-if-any policy effect and matchers that honor wildcards ("*" matches any object or action) for backend RBAC enforcement.

nodes.name: policy.csv
nodes.summary: Casbin RBAC policy matrix granting per-role permissions across ~25 resources (trips, shipments, treasury, salary, portals, geotag) for ADMIN, MANAGER, DISPATCHER, ACCOUNTANT, CUS, OPS, DRIVER, and CUSTOMER roles, with inline comments documenting wave-by-wave access decisions such as separating dispatch resources from broad shipment access.

nodes.name: migrate-trailers.ts
nodes.summary: One-off migration script that extracts trailer plates embedded in the trucks table into the standalone trailers table, deduplicating plate/type combinations and re-linking trucks, skipping entirely if trailers already exist.

nodes.name: migrateTrailers
nodes.summary: Transactionally copies unique trailer plate/type combos out of trucks into the trailers table (skipping when rows already exist) and links trucks to the new trailer records.

nodes.name: expense-accounting.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the expense source provenance bridge, canonical-cash voucher references and allocations, reconciliation and advance links, truck-accountant assignment history, and exact-key evidence attachments. Native expense owners retain monetary and invoice fields.

nodes.name: salary-exclusions.ts
nodes.summary: Salary-period driver exclusion records with period/driver identity, handling choice, actor attribution, follow-up and version metadata.

nodes.name: shipment-finance.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shipment invoice records with separate face amount and supplier fee, plus documentary container deposit records and refund tracking. Deposit records do not create cash, customer recovery or transport revenue.

nodes.name: treasury.ts
nodes.summary: Defines canonical treasury accounts and movements, including nullable company/TM fund classification, source links, physical references, cutover and reversal history.

nodes.name: role-aliases.ts
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility layer for the CLERK→CUS and FORWARDER→OPS role rename, canonicalizing legacy role names so auth and RBAC checks keep working with both spellings during the migration period.

nodes.name: canonicalizeRole
nodes.summary: Converts any role string to its canonical modern form (CLERK→CUS, FORWARDER→OPS), passing unknown roles through unchanged.

nodes.name: isLegacyRole
nodes.summary: Returns true when the given role is one of the legacy names (CLERK, FORWARDER) that still needs migration.

nodes.name: getModernRole
nodes.summary: Returns the modern replacement for a legacy role name, or null when the role is already modern or unknown.

nodes.name: areRolesEqual
nodes.summary: Compares two role strings after canonicalization so legacy and modern spellings of the same role compare equal.

nodes.name: getRoleAliasMappings
nodes.summary: Exposes the raw legacy→modern alias mapping for migration tooling and reporting.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry SDK bootstrap that must be the first import of the server entry point; configures an OTLP or console trace exporter, a ratio-based sampler driven by env vars, and Node auto-instrumentations with signal-hooked flush on shutdown.

nodes.name: readSamplerRatio
nodes.summary: Parses OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG into a 0..1 sampling ratio, rejecting out-of-range or non-finite values.

nodes.name: startSdk
nodes.summary: Builds the OTel resource, exporter, and ratio sampler, starts the NodeSDK with Node auto-instrumentations, and registers SIGTERM/SIGINT hooks that flush and shut down the tracer provider.

nodes.name: customers.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated customer master data from the 2026-07-30 Excel delivery: the LONG MINH customer record with tax codes and payment terms, plus the SilverSea company identity block (address, bank account, representative) used for invoicing.

nodes.name: drivers.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated roster of the customer's real drivers with names, tax codes, hometowns, and phone numbers, extracted from the delivered Excel report forms for seeding the identity tables.

nodes.name: factories.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated factory/receiver master data (NEWEB warehouses and similar) keyed by customer internal code, carrying raw receiver addresses, invoice tax details, driver docking notes, and Google Maps links.

nodes.name: fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated fleet roster pairing heavy truck plates with trailer plates, assigned driver names, payload limits, and preferred-route tags, mirroring the customer's real truck-trailer combinations.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the generated seed datasets (the Excel-derived ports list and its PortFromExcelSeed type) for the seed modules.

nodes.name: ports-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated port seed data (name, address, ops-portal URL, lifting fee) transcribed from the customer's DATA PM Excel workbook; regenerate with tools/generate-seed-data.mjs.

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated rate-card seed pairing routes with container sizes, revenue-share percentages, base prices, and surcharge-inclusive prices (VND) for the pricing tables.

nodes.name: prod-master-data.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated production master data from the customer's Excel delivery: staff, drivers, customers, sites, routes, tractors, trailers, ports, and carriers as typed constant arrays consumed exclusively by seed-prod.

nodes.name: reference.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated reference data for shipment intake: Hai Phong-area ports with e-port portal URLs, transport routes, and container type catalog.

nodes.name: samples.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated sample trip ledger rows (customer, factory, route, container number, receivable and payable breakdowns including freight, ferry fees, meals, and surcharges) used to seed realistic demo trip data.

nodes.name: vehicles.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated vehicle-class seed from the DATA PM workbook's vehicle-type sheet: license and trailer plates, inspection/license deadlines, per-axle load limits, driver assignments, and preferred routes.

nodes.name: wipe.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the FK-safe business-data wipe for reseeding: a preserved-tables contract (users, push_subscriptions, idempotency_keys are never touched) plus a grouped TRUNCATE ... CASCADE plan/execute pair.

nodes.name: wipeTableList
nodes.summary: Returns the flat list of business tables to wipe from the grouped plan.

nodes.name: planWipe
nodes.summary: Builds the grouped wipe plan used for dry-run output.

nodes.name: executeWipe
nodes.summary: Executes the TRUNCATE ... CASCADE across all business tables on the given database handle.

nodes.name: nginx-frontend.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx server config baked into the frontend Docker image: serves the built SPA with gzip compression, security headers, one-year immutable caching for Vite-hashed static assets, and an index.html fallback for client-side routing.

nodes.name: nginx-host-silversea.conf
nodes.summary: Production TLS reverse proxy for silversea.tingting.vip: /api reaches the backend and other traffic reaches the SPA. Public /uploads is removed in favor of authenticated photo routes; Adminer is available only through an SSH tunnel.

nodes.name: nginx-host-vantai.conf
nodes.summary: Staging TLS reverse proxy for vantai.tingting.vip: routes API and Socket.IO to the backend, the SPA to the frontend, and /adminer to the database GUI. Public /uploads is removed; photo access uses authenticated API routes.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Root typescript-eslint rules for backend/shared exclude frontend, generated output and tooling. Any/unused variables warn; unused destructured rest siblings are permitted and Express ambient namespace augmentation remains allowed.

nodes.name: fifoAging.ts
nodes.summary: FIFO receivable aging with chronological credit application and retained prepayments. Missing debit timestamps fall back to the reference date; open amounts are bucketed as at most30 days,31–60,61–90 and over90 days.

nodes.name: computeFifoAging
nodes.summary: Applies chronological credits to the oldest open debit, carries excess credit to later debits and returns open balances plus whole-VND aging buckets for≤30,31–60,61–90 and>90 days.

nodes.name: tripDriverSalary.ts
nodes.summary: Driver salary allocation helpers that prorate a monthly base salary over trips using a fixed 26-workday divisor (deliberately independent of per-month attendance standardWorkDays), with a fallback to the legacy route-default salary when no base is configured.

nodes.name: computeTripDriverSalary
nodes.summary: Allocates a driver's monthly base salary to a trip as baseSalary / 26 * tripWageDays, rounded to whole VND, returning 0 for non-finite or non-positive inputs.

nodes.name: resolveTripDriverSalary
nodes.summary: Resolves a trip's driver salary by preferring the configured-base allocation and falling back to the legacy route/default salary only when the driver has no usable base salary.

nodes.name: tripFormDefaults.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical fallback constants for trip-form math — fuel price per liter, loaded and empty fuel norms (L/100km), and road allowance per km — extracted from the frontend form so dispatcher calculations, form previews, and accountant P&L all use identical numbers when no fuel/road config is loaded.

nodes.name: api-paths.ts
nodes.summary: Shared typed REST path maps for staff and portal APIs, with parameterized builders for resource identities and nested routes.

nodes.name: driverTaskNote.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical driver-note composition and parsing: known task labels occupy the first semicolon-separated line and free text follows on later lines. Editing preserves whitespace; explicit-save normalization trims manual text and legacy unmatched text remains intact.

nodes.name: composeDriverTaskNote
nodes.summary: Joins nonblank trimmed task labels with semicolons on the first line and appends manual text on a new line without trimming its editing whitespace.

nodes.name: normalizeDriverTaskNote
nodes.summary: Trims the manual-text portion only at explicit save time while preserving a composed tag line; single-line notes are trimmed directly.

nodes.name: parseDriverTaskNote
nodes.summary: Matches exact first-line segments against known tag labels and preserves unmatched segments plus all later lines as manual text, including legacy single-line notes.

nodes.name: source-authority.ts
nodes.summary: Executable source-authority vocabulary for the Q22 business chain: typed catalogs of source/dependent authority kinds, field families, and lock milestones, plus lookup functions deciding which propagation actions (RECOMPUTE, VERSION, ADJUST, REVERSE) are allowed before or after each milestone. Deliberately computes no money and mutates nothing.

nodes.name: findSourceAuthorityPolicy
nodes.summary: Looks up the authority policy row for a (source, dependent) pair from the SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICIES list, returning undefined for unknown pairs.

nodes.name: getSourceAuthorityActions
nodes.summary: Returns the allowed propagation actions for a (source, dependent) pair at a given phase (PRE_MILESTONE or POST_MILESTONE), defaulting to an empty list when no policy exists.

nodes.name: isSourceAuthorityActionAllowed
nodes.summary: Boolean gate answering whether a specific action on a (source, dependent) pair is permitted at the given phase — the single check call sites use before propagating a source change.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public shared-package barrel re-exporting domain types, runtime schemas, labels, calculations, source-authority contracts, navigation and shipment planning for backend and frontend consumers.

nodes.name: pageCatalog.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for SPA page metadata — the canonical path and Vietnamese title for every route (dashboard, dispatch, fleet, finance, config catalogs, driver and forwarder portals, ops field pages) exposed as the typed PAGE_CATALOG constant. Static pages carry literal paths while dynamic pages provide param-based URL builders plus route patterns, deliberately leaving RBAC to App.tsx and Casbin.

nodes.name: app-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Runtime settings contracts for credit thresholds, direct financial authorization limits and salary business-unit scope.

nodes.name: customer-service-finance.ts
nodes.summary: Shared customer-finance, payment, profitability and accounting-register contracts with strict filter/sort schemas and direct-record recoverable-cost eligibility; no new internal decision payload is required.

nodes.name: email-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Zod contract for the ADMIN-only Resend email credential: the API key is write-only (GET responses expose only a masked suffix), and a payload may not both replace and clear the key in the same update.

nodes.name: financial-reporting-policy.ts
nodes.summary: Effective-dated financial reporting policy and truck depreciation profile contracts with strict whole-VND amounts and versioned history for direct authorized changes.

nodes.name: geotag.ts
nodes.summary: Shared wire contract for event-driven photo GPS geotagging: photo-bearing entity types (trip, trip-expense, company-expense photos), fix sources (phone/exif/manual), the POST /api/geotag payload with anti-replay gpsAt and warm-fix diagnostic fields, and the read-shape PhotoGeotag record. Requirements traceability comments tie accuracy/freshness gates to anti-fraud specs.

nodes.name: governance-action.ts
nodes.summary: Legacy-named types and Zod contracts for transient protected-operation adapters. Role capabilities, versions, evidence and audit shapes remain shared; these schemas do not create a persisted approval queue.

nodes.name: ocr-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Zod contract for ADMIN-only OCR settings running on an OpenRouter API key, using the same write-only key semantics as the email settings: GET returns only a masked preview, omitting the key preserves it, and an explicit flag clears it.

nodes.name: shipment-charge-proposal-link.ts
nodes.summary: Zod contract for reviewing shipment charge proposals across five fee fields, discriminated by decision: ACCEPT_LINK must target a specific debit-note document and line with optimistic-concurrency versions, while REJECT requires only a mandatory reason.

nodes.name: shipment-finance.ts
nodes.summary: Validates versioned shipment invoice and container deposit requests, including integer VND limits, real dates and consistent refund date/amount fields.

nodes.name: treasury.ts
nodes.summary: Defines company/TM fund classification and shared treasury account setup and versioned fund-assignment schemas. Older unclassified accounts retain their unknown ownership until explicitly assigned.

nodes.name: work-inbox.ts
nodes.summary: Zod contracts for the role-based work inbox: a common item base (state, parties, blockers, next action, target route) additively extended into operations, driver, customer, accountant, manager, and admin-health projections, plus the paginated response envelope pinned to the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone and the customer delivery-response decision schema that requires a reason on dispute.

nodes.name: shipment-effective.ts
nodes.summary: Pure effective-value resolvers for shipment container planning under the SILVER L1 program contract: factory precedence (container site authority, then shipment site, then legacy free-text factory name) and per-container fulfillment dates cast to the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh business timezone. Every surface that needs the effective factory or planning date resolves through these helpers instead of re-deriving precedence per endpoint.

nodes.name: resolveEffectiveFactory
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective factory for a container through the precedence chain container-level site authority, shipment-level site, then legacy free-text factory name, returning the site id, display label slot, and which level produced the value.

nodes.name: resolveEffectiveFulfillmentDate
nodes.summary: Returns the effective fulfillment/planning date: FCL containers use their appointment cast to the Vietnam local date (allowing sibling containers to plan on different days), falling back to the shipment's expected delivery date.

nodes.name: localDateInBusinessZone
nodes.summary: Casts an ISO instant or Date to its YYYY-MM-DD local date in the +07:00 business timezone via fixed-offset arithmetic, returning null for unparseable input so callers decide between fallback and invalid.

nodes.name: shipment-finance.ts
nodes.summary: Defines invoice, container deposit and paginated shipment finance response types, keeping face value, supplier cost, outstanding deposit and documentary status distinct.

nodes.name: expense-accounting-reads.service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds scoped expense projections from native owners and provenance links, suppressing billing mirrors and retaining unknown historical cash. Produces paginated entries, assignments, vouchers, reconciliations and expense-date receivable/payable reports with a separate cash cutoff. Vendor report labels resolve canonical supplier names, including inactive suppliers; CUS reads hide payment fields.

nodes.name: uniqueExpenseSources
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate legacy/native rows and trip billing mirrors even when source-kind filtering would hide the owner.

nodes.name: expensePaymentAmounts
nodes.summary: Computes as-of cash and outstanding totals from explicit source allocations; legacy or unattributed history remains unknown.

nodes.name: filterExpenseEntries
nodes.summary: Filters recorded entries by actor, dates, source, shipment, payer, vehicle, accountant and search, then applies stable sorting.

nodes.name: expenseEntryPage
nodes.summary: Paginates authorized entries and returns full-filter totals and unknown-balance counts.

nodes.name: loadSources
nodes.summary: Loads canonical native-owner projections and legacy fallbacks, suppressing mirrors and voided sources under actor shipment scope.

nodes.name: loadExpenseAccountingEntries
nodes.summary: Hydrates source entries with operational labels, evidence, payment allocations and locks, redacting CUS cash fields.

nodes.name: listExpenseAccountingEntries
nodes.summary: Loads scoped expense entries and returns their requested page and aggregate totals.

nodes.name: getExpenseAccountingEntry
nodes.summary: Reads one source reference through the same scoped expense projection and rejects unavailable entries.

nodes.name: listTruckAccountantAssignments
nodes.summary: Lists active truck-accountant assignment versions and labels for authorized finance actors.

nodes.name: getExpenseVoucher
nodes.summary: Loads a voucher with canonical treasury values, source allocations, counterparty labels and receipt unapplied amount.

nodes.name: listExpenseVouchers
nodes.summary: Returns authorized cash voucher history ordered by canonical value date and voucher identity.

nodes.name: getExpenseReconciliation
nodes.summary: Loads an authorized OPS reconciliation with expenses, actual reimbursements/refunds and remaining difference.

nodes.name: listExpenseReconciliations
nodes.summary: Lists finance-visible reconciliations or the OPS actor own reconciliation history.

nodes.name: expenseAccountingReportRows
nodes.summary: Groups expense receivables or payables by customer or carrier/payee while propagating unknown historical balances.

nodes.name: getExpenseAccountingReport
nodes.summary: Builds an unpaginated finance-authorized IN/OUT report using expense-date filters and a separately selected cash cutoff, defaulting to today in Vietnam. After aggregation, batch-loads canonical supplier names for VENDOR entity IDs, including inactive suppliers; keeps an existing label if no supplier matches and re-sorts by Vietnamese name, entity type and ID. This name resolution leaves grouping and financial totals unchanged.

nodes.name: getExpenseAccountingCatalog
nodes.summary: Loads role-appropriate classifications and finance options, including funded advances with remaining allocatable amounts.

nodes.name: advances.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder-facing advance request lists/counts, balance, settlement lists/detail/preview, Excel/HTML export and idempotent creation. Settlement detail and export use shared base-10 parseId before fetching and ownership checks, rejecting parsed IDs that are not positive integers with HTTP 400. The helper accepts numeric prefixes; missing numeric IDs retain 404 behavior.

tour.title: Product and Repository Contract
tour.description: Read the project context and agent contract before traversing the transport system. This graph intentionally covers backend, shared contracts and infrastructure; it is not frontend or physical-device verification.

tour.title: Authenticated HTTP Requests
tour.description: The Express bootstrap mounts role-scoped routes behind JWT, Casbin and audit middleware. Read the material-write registry to see how every mutating endpoint declares its audit/idempotency boundary.

tour.title: Data and Transaction Authority
tour.description: The Drizzle schema and transaction helpers underpin the request path just introduced. Idempotency records bind a command to its actor, payload and persisted result, so retries preserve the original authority and cannot silently duplicate a financial action.

tour.title: Shared Business Contracts
tour.description: Backend and frontend consume the same request schemas, lifecycle vocabulary and calculations. These contracts define operational dates and identities separately from financial arithmetic, including pending shipment details that can be supplemented later.

tour.title: Shipment Planning and Dispatch
tour.description: CUS intake and direct container/schedule supplements resolve effective factory and appointment values. The detailed dispatch list selects a single globally ordered page across fulfilled and undecomposed containers before hydration, preserving every matching row across pages. Dispatch then assigns transport authority and issues a fulfillment-backed trip under vehicle and source locks.

tour.title: Driver Tasks and Evidence
tour.description: Driver read models use the same shipment operational notes and task catalog for summary and detail. For IMPORT work, the canonical container drop-off port identifies empty-container return separately from factory delivery, while contacts and fee invoice identities preserve their own source. Progress and POD evidence remain driver-scoped, and terminal tasks cannot be accepted again.

tour.title: Direct Operations Recording
tour.description: OPS and forwarder expenses record complete valid entries directly, while incomplete historical advances use explicit record or void recovery. Settlement finalization checks source ownership, exact totals and evidence. Corrections preserve recorded history and apply ledger deltas instead of rewriting it.

tour.title: Native Expense Ownership and Confirmation
tour.description: OPS, driver, trip and invoice records retain their own financial fields. The expense source registry links that provenance to a real shipment/trip, tracks versions and confirmation, and leaves legacy cash history unknown. Confirmation creates one billing projection and recomputes actual driver transport costs under accounting locks.

tour.title: One Cash Authority Across Screens
tour.description: Expense voucher adapters use the same command identities, idempotency records and canonical ledger/treasury/receipt operations as payment APIs. Vouchers record explicit source allocations; reconciliation consumes funded advance balances, while later allocation moves no cash. Reversals update the coordinated history rather than hiding a second money book.

tour.title: Shipment Documents and Expense Reports
tour.description: Shipment invoice face value is distinct from the supplier fee, and container deposit refund fields are documentary records. Expense reads deduplicate billing mirrors and report nullable unknown balances; receivable/payable reports apply an expense-date range and a separate cash-as-of date.

tour.title: Protected Financial Changes
tour.description: The legacy-named governance adapter executes role, evidence and source-version checks in one request. Ledger, credit-exception, company-expense and billing constraints still prevent duplicate postings, stale corrections and edits to paid/final records.

tour.title: Frozen Financial Snapshots
tour.description: Salary confirmation stores the exact salary and attendance fingerprint. Driver earnings restores that same snapshot and exposes separate later adjustments; billing documents likewise retain official source identity across later operational changes.

tour.title: Runtime and Local Fixtures
tour.description: Workspace build order compiles shared contracts before their consumers. Docker, backup scripts and seed orchestration support reproducible runtime setup; their presence in this graph does not mean staging/production deployment was performed.
